# Ridge Point Remodeling and Carpentry

Ridge Point Remodeling and Carpentry is a Lake Butler, Florida home remodeling and finish carpentry business owned by Jason Miller. The legal business entity is Ridge Point Structures LLC.

## Official business details

- Address: 8831 SW 88th Ct, Lake Butler, FL 32054
- Phone: (386) 291-5200
- Email: jason@ridgepointremodeling.com
- Hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Closed major holidays.
- Service area: Lake Butler and North Florida, including Starke, Lake City, Gainesville, High Springs, Alachua, Macclenny, Live Oak, and Keystone Heights.

## Services

- Kitchen remodeling: /services/kitchen-remodeling
- Bathroom remodeling: /services/bathroom-remodeling
- Ready-to-assemble cabinet sales and cabinet installation: /services/cabinet-sales-installation
- Custom carpentry, trim, millwork, and built-ins: /services/custom-carpentry
- New decks and deck replacements: /services/deck-building
- Flooring, siding, and window updates: /services/flooring-siding-windows
